description_en: Submits a video copyright watermark job
description_zh: 提交视频版权水印任务
kebab_example: aliyun mts submit-copyright-job --call-back http://example.com/callback --description '地址_:_上海市浦东新区上科路川和路' --input Bucket_:_example-bucket_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example.flv --level 2 --message '平头哥半导体公司' --start-time 100 --total-time 1000 --biz-output Bucket_:_example-bucket_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example.flv --user-data 123 --url http://www.example.com/video/test.mp4 --visible-message abcd --params vsid_:_198 --api-version 2021-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCopyrightJob

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for the node task result
parameters.name: call_back

parameters.example: 地址 : 上海市浦东新区上科路川和路
parameters.help_en: The description of the watermark information
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The Object Storage Service (OSS) address of the media file to which you want to add a watermark. Only video files are supported. This parameter is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html.

Video copyright watermark jobs support only videos that are 3 minutes or longer. If the video is too short, the API call may fail or produce no output.

Bucket: the name of the OSS bucket for the input file.

Location: the region where OSS is located. The region must be the same as the region of ApsaraVideo Media Processing.

Object: the OSS object to be detected
parameters.help_zh:
待添加水印的媒体文件OSS地址，目前仅支持视频文件，JSON对象。详细信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

提交视频版权水印作业目前仅支持3分钟及以上视频，视频时间过短会导致接口调用失败或无输出。

Bucket：输入文件OSS Bucket名称。

Location：OSS所在地域，必须和MPS服务所在地域一致。

Object：待检测OSS Object
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The watermark strength. This parameter is an integer. Valid values: [0,2]
parameters.help_zh: 水印强度，整数，取值范围[0,2]
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The watermark information. The maximum length is 1024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 水印信息，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_en:
The OSS address for the output file.

The OSS region must be the same as the region of ApsaraVideo Media Processing
parameters.help_zh:
文件输出OSS地址。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The start time of the watermark, in seconds. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 水印起始时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为0
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the watermark, in seconds. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 水印结束时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为0
parameters.name: total_time

parameters.help_en: The custom user data. The maximum length is 1024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节
parameters.name: user_data
